name: Emulate the Exalted Dead
body:
When you emulate the legends of old, you gain abilities reminiscent of the exalted dead.

Prerequisite(s): Emulate the Legends, 10th-level chronicler

Benefit: When you use the ability granted by the Emulate the Legends feat, you also gain the following benefits: a 50% miss chance; an additional +2 bonus to your Constitution score; the ability to fly with a speed of 30 feet and good maneuverability, using either your Fly skill check bonus or a bonus equal to your chronicler level, whichever is higher; and finally, you gain the appearance of a spectral warrior, and any enemy that beholds you must succeed at a Will save or become shaken until you regain your normal appearance (DC 15 + your Charisma modifier).
